title: Scope catalog (named scopes + decision-profile archetypes)
$comment: The normative enumeration owned by dplaax.spec_draft (claims.catalog.single-owner, claims.catalog.enumerated). Named scopes and the three decision-profile archetypes with their required scope sets. Per-scope required-check definitions are filled incrementally; scopes marked p0-2-gated depend on the trusted-time / freshness / anchor decision (P0-2). The evidence-view.json `scope` enum inlines this set (no cross-file $ref) and must stay in sync.
$comment2: A catalog record: which scope set and which profile a claim contract pins.

scopeName.$comment: The named scope set (claims.scope.named). @1 is the initial version; the version suffix is part of the identity.

profileId.$comment: The three decision-profile archetypes (claims.profile.archetypes). A profileId is a distinct identity from a claimContractId (claims.contract.distinct-from-profile).

suiteContractId.$comment: The cryptosuite claim contracts (claims.suite.contract-id, P0-4 + rdfc amendment 2026-07-15). Fork W was selected, so the active jcs contract is the W3C Multikey suite; the rdfc contract is the Phase-2 opt-in W3C suite (v0-mandatory per the p0-7/p0-12 ruling — the P0-4 transcription enumerated only the jcs pair and left it without an id, found during ForkW-1 implementation review); the legacy contract is the projection of historically-emitted proofs (signer.suite.legacy-projection). The Fork C closed contract is not enumerated (unselected).

authorizationProfileId.$comment: The P0-2 lifecycle authorization profiles (claims.profile.authorization). A distinct family from the resource-action archetypes (profileId): these compose the lifecycle scopes into a historical or current verdict. historical-acceptance requires the anchored-order scopes; current-authorization requires state plus LIFECYCLE_FRESHNESS.

authContractId.$comment: The P0-3 DID login contracts (claims.login.contracts). OWNER_AUTHENTICATION_LOGIN is Fork Y (the selected default, uses the Owner authentication relationship); OWNER_ASSERTION_CONTROL_LOGIN is Fork X (documented closed-pilot option, requires machine-checked PDP containment, no authentication-relationship claim); LEGACY_DID_LOGIN is the bounded relationship-blind migration artifact.

sinkProfileId.$comment: The versioned sink profiles (effect.sink.classification, P0-5). legacy-adjacent-write@1 is a migration posture only (effect.migration.exclusive-writers): it can never issue effect contracts and ends at the legacy cutover. Kept in sync with the quarantine-entry.json inline copy.

writerCapabilityProfile.$comment: The writer conformance classes (effect.writer.capability / .limited-profile, P0-5). idempotency-capable provides at least one target-side dedup shape; limited-manual-reconciliation provides none, never auto-retries after EFFECT_UNKNOWN, and resolves ambiguity as recorded manual reconciliation.

effectContractId.$comment: The external-effect claim contracts (claims.effect.contracts, P0-5). EFFECT_CONFIRMED@1 is the only contract that means effect completion (effect.state.confirmed-only); LEGACY_SINK_RECEIPT@1 is the projection of pre-B2 receipts (claims.effect.legacy-receipt) and never re-projects upward.

scopeNotes.$comment: SEMANTIC_EXECUTION@1 is outside the protocol's decision scope (adapters / audit infrastructure own it); a protocol verifier reports it UNSUPPORTED. The P0-2 lifecycle scopes (KEY_AUTHORIZATION_AT_STATE@1, CONTROLLER_CHAIN_AUTHORIZATION_AT_STATE@1, ANCHORED_OBSERVATION_ORDER@1, LIFECYCLE_FRESHNESS@1, optional TRUSTED_OBSERVATION_TIME@1) are now enumerated and the earlier p0-2 gate is retired. TRUSTED_OBSERVATION_TIME@1 stays optional and is emitted only by a profile that contracts an independent time authority (observation.trusted-time.profile).
